solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Given a job indicated by heads of army personnel

indicators.note: the heads of the words army and personnel are their opening letters

parts.note: to have indicated something is to have pointed it out

explanation.surface: Someone is told by senior military staff which post they have been given.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone appointed has been named to a post, which is a formal way of being given a job.

clue.text: A mostly existing neighbourhood

indicators.note: mostly means most of the word for existing is kept, its last letter dropped

parts.note: something existing is real

explanation.surface: A neighbourhood that mostly exists, an odd half-real district.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: a district or locality of a town can be called either.

clue.text: Not so colourful second city of Italy

parts.note: less colourful means paler
a mo is a moment, a second

explanation.surface: A slightly drab place that ranks as Italy's second city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'second city' looks like a phrase, but 'second' belongs to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: The Sicilian capital is an example of an Italian city.

clue.text: I am beginning to pity mischievous child

parts.note: contracted, I am is I'm

indicators.note: the beginning to the word pity is its first letter

explanation.surface: Someone says they are starting to feel sorry for a naughty youngster.
explanation.definitionFit: A rascally little child is often called a little devil, a sprite of mischief.

clue.text: Fish found on both sides of river channel

indicators.note: the fish is found on both sides, so it wraps around the abbreviation for river

parts.note: the tench is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: Fish turn up along both banks of a river channel.
explanation.definitionFit: A long narrow ditch dug in the ground serves as a channel.

clue.text: Refuse to believe in record warning sign on IT

parts.note: a gramophone record is a disc
red is the colour of danger and warning signs

explanation.surface: An IT department is flagged with a warning about a record it holds.
explanation.definitionFit: To doubt or reject a claim is to refuse to believe in it.

clue.text: Regularly stand down

indicators.note: regularly means taking every other letter of the word stand, starting with the first

explanation.surface: An instruction to stand down at regular intervals.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling down means feeling unhappy, a synonym.

clue.text: Political slant seen with European part of book

parts.note: spin is the slant politicians put on news

explanation.surface: A book containing a section with a European political bias.
explanation.definitionFit: The bound back edge of a book, where the title shows on a shelf.

clue.text: Expand detail all over the place

indicators.note: letters all over the place are scattered, so the word detail is rearranged

explanation.surface: A request to elaborate on a detail in many places.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: to widen or enlarge, as a pupil does in the dark.

clue.text: Obscure snippets of film in middle of reel

indicators.note: the snippets sit in the middle letters of reel, which surround them
the middle of the word reel is its central pair of letters

parts.note: short extracts of film are clips

explanation.surface: Hard-to-follow film snippets spliced into the middle of a reel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Obscure' looks like an adjective describing the snippets but it is a verb, the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To block from view, as the moon does to the sun, is to obscure it.

clue.text: Small tablet for upset

parts.note: a medicinal tablet is a pill

explanation.surface: A little tablet taken for an upset stomach.
explanation.definitionFit: To knock over or tip out a drink is to upset it.

clue.text: What might put one off course of hybrid fruit, we hear

definitions.text: What might put one off course

indicators.note: we hear means the phrase sounds like the answer when spoken

parts.note: a cross is a hybrid, and a currant is a small fruit

explanation.surface: Asking what might deflect someone from a course of cross-bred fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'course' suggests a meal course of fruit, but it is a route at sea.
explanation.definitionFit: A water flow running across the main stream pushes a swimmer or boat off its route.

clue.text: Pronounced pirate prohibited in West Indies group

indicators.note: pronounced means the words are said aloud and their sound gives the answer

parts.note: to pirate is to steal, and prohibited means banned

explanation.surface: A notorious pirate was barred from the Caribbean islands.
explanation.definitionFit: Caribbean musical ensembles playing pans made from oil drums originated in Trinidad.

clue.text: Additional customs finally must be cut

indicators.note: the final letter of the word for customs must be cut off

parts.note: mores are the customs of a society

explanation.surface: Extra customs duties must ultimately be reduced.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: further or extra, as in 'some extra tea'.

clue.text: Idiot to engage in strenuous exercises?

parts.note: to engage in an activity is to do it
PE is physical education, school exercises

explanation.surface: Only a fool would take on hard physical exercise.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal synonym: a stupid person is called this in slang.

clue.text: Undertaking concert that is including Nielsen's Fifth

parts.note: a prom is a promenade concert, as at the BBC Proms

indicators.note: the abbreviation for that is takes in the picked letter

parts.note: i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, that is

indicators.note: the fifth letter of the name Nielsen's

explanation.surface: A concert programme that includes Nielsen's Fifth Symphony.
explanation.walkthrough: Carl Nielsen was a Danish composer; his Fifth is a symphony, but here it means his name's fifth letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a pledge or commitment given to someone is an undertaking.

clue.text: Chesty upset which may lay one low

indicators.note: upset means the letters of the word Chesty are overturned and rearranged

explanation.surface: A chesty illness that might lay someone low in bed.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a chest infection; the definition means a mowing tool that cuts grass down, and the Grim Reaper's emblem.
explanation.definitionFit: A long curved blade cuts crops to the ground, and Death carries one.

clue.text: Repeats second half of speech and does without the first

indicators.note: the second half of the word speech is its last three letters
the word does loses its first letter

explanation.surface: Someone repeats the second half of a speech and leaves out its opening.
explanation.definitionFit: Reverberations repeat a sound, and as a verb the word means repeats.

clue.text: Competition has lion eating one smaller feline in difficulty

indicators.note: the lion eats, so it surrounds the other letters

parts.note: taken as written
I is the Roman numeral one
a cat is a smaller feline than a lion

explanation.surface: A contest where a lion devours a lesser cat, which causes trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: A complicating factor is a difficulty or snag.

clue.text: Was absorbed by thoughts of millions getting exploited

parts.note: M is the abbreviation for million
to be exploited is to be used

explanation.surface: Someone lost in thought about millions of people being exploited.
explanation.definitionFit: To ponder or reflect at length is to be absorbed in thought.

clue.text: Close second house that's far from grand

parts.note: a hut is a humble dwelling

explanation.surface: Shutting up a modest second home.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to close a door is to shut it.

clue.text: Operatic heroine — a round figure in cast, unfortunately

indicators.note: the figure goes in the word cast, inside it
unfortunately suggests things go wrong, so the letters are disordered

parts.note: a round figure is O, a zero or a circle

explanation.surface: A plump singer has, alas, been cast as the opera's heroine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts O inside CAST to make COAST, which 'unfortunately' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: Puccini's opera is named after its singer heroine, a famous soprano role.

clue.text: Large bird, superlatively full of flavour with first piece cut

indicators.note: the opening letter of the combined words is cut off

parts.note: most forms the superlative of an adjective
rich food is full of flavour

explanation.surface: A big bird served up as the tastiest dish, though the first portion is carved off.
explanation.definitionFit: The flightless African bird is the largest living bird.

clue.text: Calling out a number in addition

indicators.note: calling out means the word is said aloud

parts.note: two is a number

explanation.surface: Someone shouts out a number as an extra item.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: also or as well.

clue.text: Editor's introduced new goal

indicators.note: the editor has introduced a letter, putting it inside

parts.note: ED is the abbreviation for editor, with 's read as has
N is the abbreviation for new; the answer also reads backwards across introduced new, a coincidence

explanation.surface: An editor has brought in a fresh target.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an aim or objective, as in 'means to an end'.

clue.text: Ruin notes written out for cheating

parts.note: to dish someone's chances is to ruin them

indicators.note: notes written out are set down afresh in a new order

explanation.surface: Copying out a ruined set of notes to cheat in an exam.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: someone cheating is being deceitful or untruthful.
